direction_notes: Phase-amplitude coupling between theta-gamma and alpha-ripple bands increased with ultrasonic intensity relative to the pre-FUS control.
safety_notes: Authors judged the dose safe because the maximum intensity was below diagnostic imaging limits; no tissue assessment reported.

exposures.label: FUS to rat hippocampus at 3.9, 9.6, 19.2 W/cm2

timing.protocol_description: A single stimulation consisted of 4-cycle (1.6 us) ultrasound pulses at a PRF of 500 Hz and a duration of 160 ms (80 repetitions). Transducer coupled via a plastic cone and gel; LFPs recorded before and after FUS.

source_quotes.n_subjects: A total of six Sprague-Dawley rats (3-month-old males, body weights 270 g) were used in the experiment.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: In our study, the ultrasound transducer, with a bandwidth of 50% and focal length of 30 mm, was driven at a high frequency (2.5 MHz).
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: A single stimulation consisted of 4 cycle (1.6 µs) ultrasound pulses with a pulse repetition frequency of500 Hz and a duration of160 ms (80 repetitions).
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: A single stimulation consisted of 4 cycle (1.6 µs) ultrasound pulses with a pulse repetition frequency of500 Hz and a duration of160 ms (80 repetitions).

flags.reason: Paper calls these 'spatial-average pulse-average' intensities measured with a sound power meter of 9.5 mm diameter; the metric is not Isppa and the medium is not stated.
Stated as 4 cycles (1.6 us); converted to ms.
Duration of 160 ms (80 repetitions) converted to s; inter-stimulus interval and number of stimulations not stated.
Transducer maker not named; only the Ultratek driver card.
